checks.evidence: Payload CRC covers all 4120 record bytes; header CRC covers all 32 header bytes with header_crc32 encoded as zero.
checks.name: crc_coverage_is_unambiguous

checks.evidence: No arena ID, landing zone, shot path, or board-position field exists in the header or record.
checks.name: version_one_excludes_arena_dependent_fields

fields.access: Little-endian header at trailer offset 0; readiness width records the 32-bit magic and CRC geometry rather than total structure size.
fields.evidence: Approved Milestone 6B format fixes magic G2DT, version 1, 32-byte header, 40-byte records, first ID 1, count 103, CRC fields, and zero reserved values.
fields.lifetime: Raw NitroFS trailer and host tooling.
fields.name: g2dt_header_geometry
fields.scripted_behavior: Malformed or unsupported header must fall back to legacy Gate behavior.

fields.access: Record offset = 32 + (card_id - 1) * 40; readiness width records the 32-bit offset arithmetic rather than total record size.
fields.evidence: The full roster requires 103 * 40 = 4120 payload bytes; with the 32-byte header the exact trailer size is 4152 bytes.
fields.initialization: Authoring serializer emits card IDs 1 through 103 in order.
fields.lifetime: Raw NitroFS trailer; one selected record may be cached for a battle.
mutations: Host rebuild replaces the complete trailer atomically.
fields.name: gate_record_geometry
fields.player_ai_behavior: Same record geometry for human and AI battles.
fields.reset: Cache reload on Gate identity change or invalidation.
fields.scripted_behavior: Scripted Gate IDs use the same validated lookup; invalid IDs fall back to legacy behavior.

fields.access: JSON Schema validation before binary serialization; readiness width is an unsigned one-byte pass/fail contract marker.
fields.evidence: Schema bounds every scalar and six-entry vector and reserves ID 255 and nonzero reserved fields.
fields.initialization: Version 1 schema with all fields required and no additional properties.
mutations: Schema changes require a new format version.
fields.name: authoring_schema
fields.scripted_behavior: Arena-dependent fields are absent from version 1.

fields.access: serialize_header, parse_header, serialize_record, parse_record, build_trailer, and parse_trailer; readiness width is an unsigned one-byte success marker.
fields.evidence: Round-trip tests require exact 32-byte and 40-byte geometry, sorted IDs 1-103, and a 4152-byte output.
fields.name: serializer
fields.scripted_behavior: Exactly the same bytes are generated for identical records.

fields.access: Called by every parser and serializer; readiness width is an unsigned one-byte validation result marker.
fields.evidence: Unit tests cover geometry, bounds, duplicate IDs, unsupported target mode, nonzero reserved data, and payload corruption.
fields.name: validator
fields.player_ai_behavior: Same failure policy for all battles.
fields.scripted_behavior: Unsupported version, flags, IDs, target modes, phases, reserved values, ordering, sizes, or CRCs are rejected.

fields.access: One object per Gate calculation with ordered integer components; readiness width is the unsigned trace format version byte.
fields.evidence: The trace format uses integer source components and final results so runtime and host calculations can be compared without floating-point ambiguity.
fields.initialization: Trace version, card ID, legacy fallback flag, core G snapshot, flat, percentage, attribute, condition, drawback, final bonus, final type, and validation status.
mutations: Append-only diagnostic output; never authoritative gameplay state.
fields.name: calculation_trace_format
fields.player_ai_behavior: Identical fields for human and AI calculations.
fields.scripted_behavior: Records final post-override type and whether legacy fallback was used.

header.header_crc32: CRC-32/ISO-HDLC over the complete 32-byte header with this field zeroed
